mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 1.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.7% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.7%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal broad economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day forward returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 (index) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 95).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1250 thousand units indicates weak consumer demand for housing, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1250).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 thousand persons signals strong labor market growth, supporting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and decreases in UNRATE indicate a tight labor market with monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with tight labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls.
